title: Korona Yakakwikwidza Matenga
intro: Munzira dzeumambo hwekare, zita remumwe mutongi rakava chirahwe chehudzvanyiriri nekuzvikudza. Muranda anozvininipisa waAllah paakasvika aine zviratidzo zvisingarambiki, mambo uyu ane simba akaramba kubvuma chokwadi. Nhasi, basa rako nderekuziva munhu uyu ane mukurumbira ane hutongi hwakaputsika uye mugumo wake wakavharirwa pasi pemafungu.
clues: Ndini mutongi anotyiwa zvikuru ane zita richiri kutaurwa senyevero kwemakore akawanda.
Ndakarayira vanhu vose kuti vashande vakasungwa necheni, vachigadzira zvifananidzo zvaizivisa kubwinya kwangu.
Mutumwa waAllah paakauya pamberi pangu nezviratidzo zvisingarambiki, ndakaramba kukotama ndikati uroyi.
Ndakarayira kuurayiwa kwevanakomana vacheche pakati pevanhu vakatapwa, ndichitarisira kuvadzvinyirira vasati vamuka.
Ndakamira pamberi pedare rangu ndikati, 'Ndiri ishe wenyu wepamusoro-soro,' ndichida kunamatwa samwari.
Gurukota rangu guru riri padivi pangu, ndakavaka chivako chakareba chakagadzirirwa kukwira kupfuura matenga.
verse: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed. (79:17)
